caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object composed of three stacked, cylindrical tiers, each progressively smaller towards the top. The uppermost tier is shaped like a cone, featuring a circular ring at its apex. The object is rendered in shades of gray with blue and brown rust-like areas, and each tier is punctuated with evenly spaced round holes. Extending from the sides of each tier are several curved, thin, dark rods, each ending in a flat, flower-shaped holder that supports a small rectangular or cylindrical shape, suggesting candle holders. The background is plain and beige, providing no additional context or objects.
title: Tin Candelabra
